_comment: Hand-picked wide-scene descriptions for story illustrations, keyed by story id. Generated separately from character portraits (which use Gemini via generate_character_art.py) -- this batch is generated on Google Colab's free-tier T4 GPU with an open-source model (SDXL + a community 'Pixar Style' LoRA, see colab_story_art_sdxl.ipynb), specifically to avoid further Gemini API spend. Not the full 324 stories yet -- this is a small first batch to validate the open-source pipeline before committing to the rest. david_and_goliath and crucifixion were rewritten after the first test batch (plain SDXL base, no LoRA) rendered Goliath as a sci-fi robot and the crucifixion as a monochrome stock-photo silhouette -- both scene descriptions now explicitly guard against the specific failure seen.
story_creation: God's Spirit hovering over a vast cosmic void of swirling light and darkness, the very first moment of creation, stars and galaxies just beginning to form in the distance
story_the_flood: Noah's massive wooden ark floating on a vast flooded world under a breaking stormy sky, distant mountain peaks barely visible above the waterline, a single beam of light breaking through the clouds
story_feeding_the_5000: Jesus and his disciples distributing bread and fish among a vast seated crowd on a grassy hillside at golden hour, overflowing baskets of food being carried through the crowd
story_david_and_goliath: young David facing Goliath, a giant of a MAN (fully human, not a robot or machine) wearing bronze scale armor and a leather kilt, across the battlefield of the valley of Elah, a sling raised in David's hand, both armies watching tensely from either side
story_crucifixion: three crosses on a hill outside Jerusalem at dusk, warm dramatic sunset light illuminating the mourners' faces and clothing in full color (not pure black silhouettes), a small group gathered at a respectful distance below, a darkened stormy sky overhead
story_lions_den: Daniel, his face clearly lit and visible, standing calm and unharmed among several realistic lions (not dogs or other animals) in a torchlit stone den, soldiers and the king peering down anxiously from an opening high above
